run_predator_prey_episode: run the predator_prey human player episode with WASD movement and Q/E turning controls
run_predator_prey_level: run the predator_prey human player on a specific level like predator_prey__alley_hunt or predator_prey__open
run_predator_prey_verbose: run the predator_prey human player with verbose mode enabled to print player stamina debug information
run_predator_prey_events: run the predator_prey human player with event printing enabled to log game events
run_predator_prey_custom_settings: run the predator_prey human player with custom JSON settings passed via the --settings argument
